message:
test(ka-pc r3): a log line counts only when written after its own action

The negative control run (a864105's page, R4 failing as it should) also failed '...exactly one' in N2: the shell had
let A go correctly (07:40:06, one line), but the test's log_has matched R1's identical earlier line at once and
counted the slice before the new line was written. The eviction, the user's release of C and A's SessionEnded are
now read from the log after the action that causes them (log_since).
